about: Candidate communities for the video engine's niche pick (Todd, live chat, Nov 9, 2026, 4:00 pm and the 4:28 pm niche research chat). Read by tools/yt_niche.py through .github/workflows/yt-niche.yml: a push that changes this file starts one read. The first four niches are Todd's candidates; the other six are added ones to test against them. pubkey_pem is the public half of a one-chat key pair: results with other people's words are sealed to it and land on the throwaway branch niche-results, never on main. Round 2 (same day): story-format queries added per niche so faceless story channels are sampled fairly; earlier queries come from the search cache.
